r13_contract.comparisonModel: The engine output P is the maximum output the propulsion machinery can continuously deliver to the propeller(s). If the output is restricted by technical means or regulations, P shall be taken as the restricted output.

test_cases.rationale: Unrestricted propulsion output equals continuously deliverable propulsion machinery output.
Restricted-output branch uses the technically/regulatorily restricted output.
Additional propulsion source is included in total engine output.
Restricted main propulsion plus additional propulsion power are both included.
Total omits available additional propulsion power.
Restricted-output branch incorrectly uses unrestricted continuous output.
Restricted output value is missing while a restriction applies.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
